threshold_selection: maximize grouped-calibration balanced accuracy with at most10percent photometric-control rejection; not validated on real blur
calibration: 14 original normal reference parents; grouped seven-fold validation; photometric controls, Gaussian and directional motion blur
mask_region: eroded gear interior; no synthetic mask-border edges
edge_metric: custom gradient-profile FWHM proxy, not CPBD
score_meaning: synthetic-calibration blur score; not a calibrated real-world probability
uncertain_rule: score between thresholds, fewer than8 edge profiles, fewer than50 interior pixels, or object minor side below half reference10thpercentile; quarantine for review
training_targets: only synthetic blur labels on normal references; no UC1 query labels or anomaly scores used
